pack_name: Oil and Gas Sector Compliance Overlay
description: Sector-specific screening controls for UK offshore oil and gas, petroleum licensing, OPRED environmental regulation, decommissioning, incident reporting, HSE/offshore safety, and operational compliance documentation.

metadata.scope: UK sector overlay controls for Oil and Gas Sector Compliance Overlay. Intended to be used with uk_core_control_library.
metadata.source_note: Source basis is mapped from official UK legal/regulatory sources available at rule-pack publication time. This starter pack is not legal advice and requires expert validation before production reliance.
metadata.external_knowledge_policy: No external knowledge is introduced during document evaluation. Regulatory source mappings live only in this versioned rule pack.

primary_sources.name: Offshore Petroleum Regulator for Environment and Decommissioning - About us
Oil and gas: environmental alerts and incident reporting
Oil & Gas: decommissioning of offshore installations and pipelines
NSTA licensing and consents / Petroleum Act regulatory framework
primary_sources.issuer: North Sea Transition Authority (business name of the Oil and Gas Authority)
used_for: petroleum licensing, operator approvals and consents

limitations: Rules encode document-evidence checks, not a final legal determination.
Each rule requires validation against current UK laws, regulations, regulator notices, codes and guidance before production reliance.
UK rules may differ between England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland; human reviewers must verify territorial applicability.

rules.title: Petroleum licence or NSTA authorisation evidence is present
rules.summary: Checks for petroleum-licence, operator-approval or consent evidence from the North Sea Transition Authority (the business name of the Oil and Gas Authority), including UKCS licence references.

metadata.evidence_expectation: The reviewed document/document set should contain direct textual evidence for this control, or the engine should return missing/review_required according to the rule strategy.
metadata.review_guidance: Automated results are evidence-based screening signals only. A qualified UK legal/compliance reviewer must confirm applicability, legal sufficiency, and treatment of missing evidence before reliance.
source_basis: Petroleum Act licensing framework / North Sea Transition Authority (Oil and Gas Authority)
